scripts.page:dev: pnpm sdk:build && concurrently -k "pnpm --filter jmcomic-sdk watch" "pnpm --filter @tiny-client/page dev"
scripts.worker:dev: pnpm sdk:build && concurrently -k "pnpm --filter jmcomic-sdk watch" "pnpm --filter @tiny-client/worker dev"
scripts.dev: pnpm sdk:build && concurrently -k "pnpm --filter jmcomic-sdk watch" "pnpm --filter @tiny-client/worker dev" "wait-on tcp:localhost:8787 && VITE_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8787 pnpm --filter @tiny-client/page dev"
scripts.test:integration: concurrently "pnpm run worker:dev" "wait-on tcp:localhost:8787 && node scripts/test-integration.js"
